description.value:
“I know you signed up as a rifleman, but we need a machine gunner in the squad. Plus, this new LMG from those tech-wizzes overseas is dead simple to use. Seriously, you hold the trigger and you’re guaranteed to hit SOMETHING. Just be careful, ‘cause if you break it… well I was going to say you buy it, but you can’t afford it.”

Cost: 10,000eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 60 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Buffer Stock, Drum Magazine, Foregrip, Magrail Kit (w/ Auto-Compensator & Jue Long Scope), Match Trigger, Smartgun Link • Mods: Modular Rails

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6). While this weapon is wielded in two hands, its user gains a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots and Autofire Checks [EQ + Foregrip] and when rolling for its Autofire Attack damage, the user rolls an additional 1d6 and drop the lowest damage die (3d6, Drop Lowest) before applying the multiplier [Buffer Stock]. Targets attempting to dodge Aimed Shots and Held Action Attacks (of any kind) from this weapon suffer a -1 penalty to their Check to do so [Match Trigger]. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Buffer Stock, Drum Magazine, Foregrip, Magrail Kit (w/ Auto-Compensator & Jue Long Scope), Match Trigger, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Modular Rails
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
